originalTitle: GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto 6) - Official Extended Gameplay
content: Take a look at Extended Gameplay for GTA 6, the latest entry in the third-person open-world action-adventure Grand Theft Auto franchise developed by Rockstar Games. Players will return to a modern-day Vice City as Jason and Lucia embark on a thrilling adventure full of action, consequence, and hilarity, signature to the franchise. Check out a suite of gameplay clips from missions, dialogue sequences, combat, and more, all captured on PlayStation 5. Grand Theft Auto 6 is launching on November 19 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S. #IGN #Gaming #GTA6
